signedOut.source: Sign in to read your history.
signedOut.text: 登录以读取您的历史记录。

unavailable.source: Owned history is unavailable. Privacy, ownership or storage capabilities may not be admitted on this deployment.
unavailable.text: 自己拥有的历史记录不可用。此部署可能尚未准入隐私、所有权或存储能力。

scope.source: Current store only. Recorded provenance describes the saved run; unknown metadata stays unknown. Settled receipt amounts exclude simulated and pending payments. Missing receipts do not prove zero spend.
scope.text: 仅限当前存储。记录的来源信息描述已保存研究；未知元数据仍为未知。已结算凭证金额不含模拟和等待确认的付款。缺少凭证不证明支出为零。

walletOnly.source: This deployment supports this verified wallet only; stored multiwallet membership is unavailable.
walletOnly.text: 此部署仅支持此已验证钱包；存储中的多钱包成员关系不可用。

claimsMissing.source: Anonymous claimed-run history is unavailable on this deployment.
claimsMissing.text: 此部署不提供匿名已认领研究历史。

empty.source: No matching runs in this scan page.
empty.text: 此扫描页没有匹配的研究。

scanLimited.source: The bounded scan continues. Use Next even when this page is empty.
scanLimited.text: 有界扫描仍在继续。即使此页为空，也请使用下一页。

exportScope.source: Exports are bounded to 20 pages / 1,000 rows / 2 MiB and carry explicit completion and continuation metadata.
exportScope.text: 导出最多包含 20 页 / 1,000 行 / 2 MiB，并附带明确的完成和继续读取元数据。

sponsored.text: 其他付款者的已结算支出

confirmErase.source: Delete this run's research text? Financial records are retained. This cannot be undone.
confirmErase.text: 删除此次研究的研究文本？财务记录将保留。此操作无法撤销。

failed.source: The operation was refused or unavailable. Refresh before retrying a revision change.
failed.text: 操作被拒绝或不可用。重试修订更改前请刷新。

memberReadOnly.source: Changing a member wallet's run requires that wallet's interactive session; history read does not grant mutation authority.
memberReadOnly.text: 更改成员钱包的研究需要该钱包的交互会话；读取历史记录不授予更改权限。

paidCreators.source: Cited creators with recorded settled citation receipts
paidCreators.text: 具有记录在案的已结算引用凭证的被引用创作者

receiptBound.source: Receipt projection truncated; spend totals unavailable.
receiptBound.text: 凭证投影已截断；支出总额不可用。

privateJobs.auth.signIn.source: Sign in to view completed private jobs
privateJobs.auth.signIn.text: 登录以查看已完成的私人任务

privateJobs.auth.waiting.source: Private data cleared. Waiting for a fresh verified sign-in.
privateJobs.auth.waiting.text: 私人数据已清除。正在等待新的已验证登录。

privateJobs.detail.citation.text: ${marker} ${sourceName}${itemTitle ? ` — ${itemTitle}` : ""}：${rationale}。记录的奖励分配：${recordedRewardUsdc} USDC（结算信息不可用）。

privateJobs.detail.claimCoverage.text: 已保存的论点覆盖情况

privateJobs.detail.decision.source: ${action} ${sourceName}: ${rationale}. Recorded offer price: ${price} USDC; this is not settled own spend.
privateJobs.detail.decision.text: ${action} ${sourceName}：${rationale}。记录的报价：${price} USDC；这不是你已结算的支出。

privateJobs.detail.introduction.source: Recorded engine: ${engine}. Saved: ${savedAt}. Incoming payment evidence only; no creator ledger.
privateJobs.detail.introduction.text: 记录的引擎：${engine}。保存时间：${savedAt}。仅有收款证据；无创作者账本。

privateJobs.detail.support.source: Recorded support: ${support}; recorded reward eligibility: ${qualifiesForReward} (settlement unavailable).
privateJobs.detail.support.text: 记录的支持情况：${support}；记录的奖励资格：${qualifiesForReward}（结算信息不可用）。

privateJobs.detail.unavailableLegacy.source: unavailable in this saved legacy result
privateJobs.detail.unavailableLegacy.text: 此已保存的旧结果中不可用

privateJobs.download.complete.source: Downloaded ${rows} rows. This bounded current-store scan finished; archives and linked wallets are excluded.
privateJobs.download.complete.text: 已下载 ${rows} 行。此次有界当前存储扫描已完成；不包括归档和关联钱包。

privateJobs.download.scope.source: Manual metadata downloads start at the beginning of the applied filters: at most 20 pages, 500 rows and 2 MiB. They exclude result bodies and payment authorizations. Keep downloads private.
privateJobs.download.scope.text: 手动元数据下载从已应用筛选的起点开始：最多 20 页、500 行和 2 MiB。不包含结果正文和付款授权。请妥善保密下载文件。

privateJobs.download.truncated.source: Downloaded ${rows} rows. Export is truncated at its bounds; it is not your whole history.
privateJobs.download.truncated.text: 已下载 ${rows} 行。导出已按边界截断；这不是你的全部历史记录。

privateJobs.errors.changedSession.source: Your authenticated session changed. Private data has been cleared. Check your sign-in before reading again.
privateJobs.errors.changedSession.text: 你的已验证会话已更改。私人数据已清除。再次读取前请检查登录。

privateJobs.errors.forbidden.source: Access to private history was refused. Private data has been cleared.
privateJobs.errors.forbidden.text: 访问私人历史记录被拒绝。私人数据已清除。

privateJobs.errors.invalidFilters.source: Check the filters. Dates must be UTC ISO timestamps, in increasing order.
privateJobs.errors.invalidFilters.text: 请检查筛选条件。日期必须是按先后顺序排列的 UTC ISO 时间戳。

privateJobs.errors.missingResult.source: This completed private result is no longer available.
privateJobs.errors.missingResult.text: 此已完成的私人结果已不可用。

privateJobs.errors.unauthorized.source: Your sign-in expired or was revoked. Private data has been cleared. Check your sign-in before reading again.
privateJobs.errors.unauthorized.text: 登录已过期或被撤销。私人数据已清除。再次读取前请检查登录。

privateJobs.errors.unavailable.source: Private history is unavailable. No successful empty history is being reported.
privateJobs.errors.unavailable.text: 私人历史记录不可用。这不表示已成功读取到空历史记录。

privateJobs.filters.scope.source: Dates select intent-list time. Surface and network come from recorded provenance and incoming settlement. Missing legacy surface remains UNKNOWN.
privateJobs.filters.scope.text: 日期按意图列表时间筛选。渠道和网络来自记录的来源与收款结算。旧记录缺失的渠道仍为 UNKNOWN。

privateJobs.page.introduction.source: Read saved private results for your signed-in payer wallet. This history covers the current store, with bounded scans and downloads.
privateJobs.page.introduction.text: 读取已登录付款钱包保存的私人结果。此历史涵盖当前存储，扫描和下载均有边界。

privateJobs.page.link.text: 已完成的私人任务与下载

privateJobs.page.metadataTitle.text: 已完成的私人任务 · Keryx

privateJobs.row.completion.text: 完成于 ${createdAt}；保存于 ${savedAt}。模式：${researchMode}；模型：${model}。

privateJobs.row.incoming.source: Settled incoming original price: ${amount}. Evidence: ${evidenceSource}; chain finality independently verified: no.
privateJobs.row.incoming.text: 已结算的原始收款价格：${amount}。证据：${evidenceSource}；链上最终性已独立验证：否。

privateJobs.row.provenance.text: 记录的网络：${network}。渠道：${surface}；所有权归属方式：${ownershipMethod}。

privateJobs.row.unavailableSettlement.source: Own settled source spend: unavailable (NULL). Creator rewards: unavailable (NULL). Paid creators: unavailable (NULL).
privateJobs.row.unavailableSettlement.text: 你已结算的来源支出：不可用（NULL）。创作者奖励：不可用（NULL）。已获付款的创作者：不可用（NULL）。

privateJobs.scan.emptyPage.source: No completed jobs matched this scanned page.
privateJobs.scan.emptyPage.text: 此扫描页中没有匹配的已完成任务。

privateJobs.scan.emptyStore.source: No completed jobs matched this current-store scan.
privateJobs.scan.emptyStore.text: 此次当前存储扫描中没有匹配的已完成任务。

privateJobs.scan.exhausted.source: This bounded current-store scan is exhausted. This is not an archive or transaction snapshot.
privateJobs.scan.exhausted.text: 此次有界当前存储扫描已结束。这不是归档或交易快照。

privateJobs.scan.limited.source: This scan reached its bound. More intents remain; an empty page does not mean your history is empty.
privateJobs.scan.limited.text: 扫描已达边界。仍有更多意图；空页不代表历史记录为空。

privateJobs.scan.more.source: More intents remain. Load the next page manually.
privateJobs.scan.more.text: 仍有更多意图。请手动加载下一页。

privateJobs.scan.navigationBound.source: Reached the 20-page navigation bound. Narrow the filters or refresh to start a new scan.
privateJobs.scan.navigationBound.text: 已达 20 页浏览边界。请缩小筛选范围或刷新以开始新扫描。

privateJobs.scan.summary.source: Page ${page}: ${rows} completed rows from ${intents} scanned intents (maximum 25 per request).
privateJobs.scan.summary.text: 第 ${page} 页：从 ${intents} 个已扫描意图中得到 ${rows} 行已完成记录（每次请求最多 25 个）。

privateJobs.status.detail.text: 正在加载已保存的私人结果…

privateJobs.status.export.text: 正在准备有界私人导出…

privateJobs.status.list.text: 正在加载已完成的私人任务…
